notes: Real clip (window 2.4-3.6 s of S05.mp4): tight, level, eye-height close-up of the young man facing the lens, nearly frontal. Head (hair-incl.) is ~0.43 of frame width at the window start and grows ~15% to ~0.49 by the end (glasses 0.30 -> 0.35 W): a slow push-in / lean-in with no pan or tilt and a stable background. Face centre x ~0.47-0.48 W; hair top is cropped by the top frame edge; glasses sit at y ~0.45 H the whole window; chin 0.80 H -> 0.86 H; silver jacket collar/shoulders fill the bottom. Hands: both at the glasses temples at the start (k=0-7), the left hand (image right) drops out by ~k=14 while the right hand (image left) curls into a point and extends to the lens in the lower-left foreground (k=21-28, blurred). Background: teal underground garage seen down the aisle: a row of ceiling tubes converging to the centre (nearest at the top-right corner ~(0.93,0.08), then ~(0.76,0.27), ~(0.67,0.34), 4 m pitch), a red beam/stripe at y~0.3 H, concrete columns at x~0.86 W (right) and ~0.1-0.25 W (left), dark car-ish mass bottom-left, floor in the lower third. Previs: lens 50 mm, camera level at z=1.911 on the aisle axis x=1.64 looking +Y; figure at (1.625,-1.35) lifted 0.33 m so that the camera is at eye height while the 3.0 m builder ceiling is only ~1.1 m above the lens (the real ceiling is low, ~0.9 m above the eye) - this reproduces the real tube positions, beam height and column positions; figure_yaw 180 (faces lens), action flick. Camera dollies in 0.088 m (0.65 -> 0.562 m to the head centre = +15% head size, same as real). Head ball: width 0.42 -> 0.47 W, centre ~(0.47,0.43), chin 0.83 -> 0.88 H, top cropped, i.e. within ~0.05 of the real head centre/size. Car moved to (-1.4,11) yaw 0 so it reads as a dark mass bottom-left behind. Checked with edge overlays and 50% blends at k=0/7/14/21/28. Remaining mismatches: (1) the mannequin arms cannot be framed at this head scale (shoulders are 0.225 m off-axis, outside the +-0.23 m frame at head depth), so the hands at the glasses and the foreground flick hand are NOT visible, only the head; (2) the builder's flick gesture slides the visor (sunglasses) from forehead to eye level at k~9-12 (2-3 frames) whereas in the real window the glasses are already on the nose: visor is ~0.14 H too high for k<10, then within ~0.05 H of the real glasses; the 3-frame slide shows up as a 7x-median frame-difference spike (continuous motion, checked frame by frame, not a pop); (3) head is a ball with a box visor, head tilt/hair/face detail absent; (4) the real VP is ~0.55 W, previs VP 0.5 W; builder tubes are thinner/smaller than the real bright tubes; (5) floor is ~20% farther below the camera than the real one because of the lifted-figure trick.
